notes.title: 1.1.4 balance update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello, agents!
 
How are those runs going? We hope you have reached security level 10 and given hell to INFINITY!

We've released a new update to fix some bugs and balance agents [b]J4X[/b] and [b]K31[/b]!

Read the patch notes for more details, and feel free to join our [url=https://tblink.co/NKDiscord]Official Discord server[/url] if you have any feedback or questions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/f369e1a437756fbaed0f661c3dc94547f252e378.png[/img]

[list][*]Fixed J4X hitting himself with [i]Clinch[/i]
[*]Fixed Achievements received in Tutorial
[*]Fixed [i]Mission Impossible[/i] Achievement[/list]
[b]J4X Balance Changes[/b]
[list][*][i]One Two[/i]: Changed from multi-target to single-target
[*][i]Dempsey Roll[/i]: Increased energy cost and damage of basic version; upgraded version is unchanged
[*][i]Dethrone[/i]: [list][*]Increased energy cost from 1 to 2
[*]Damage increased by 33%
[*]Heal effect changed to fixed value, equal to base damage[/list]
[*][i]Meteoric Punch[/i]: 
[list][*]Increased Damage by 50%
[*]Replaced [i]“Hold”[/i] with [i]“Apply 2 Stun (3 upgraded). Consume”[/i][/list]
[*][i]Taunt[/i]: Reduced combo requirement of basic version from 5 to 4; reduced draw to 1[/list]
[b]K31 Balance Changes[/b]
[list][*][i]Love and Peace[/i]: Added [i]Consume[/i]
[*][i]Guns Blazing[/i]: Energy cost increased by 1
[*][i]Kneecap[/i]:
[list][*]Changed from Melee to Ranged
[*]Changed from multi-target to single-target[/list]
[*][i]Lock and Load[/i]: 
[list][*]Increased basic card energy cost to 2
[*]Removed draw effect[/list]
[*][i]Powder Monkey[/i]
[list][*]Reduced basic card energy cost to 3
[*]Reduced upgraded energy cost to 1
[*]Removed [i]Cost Down[/i]
[*]Added [i]Consume[/i][/list]
[*][i]Jungle Style[/i]: Removed [i]Consume[/i]
[*][i]Reassess[/i]: Added [i]Consume[/i]
[*][i]Cannibalise[/i]: Added [i]Consume[/i]
[*][i]Cargo Pants[/i]:
[list][*]Increased basic card energy cost from 1 to 2
[*]Reduced upgraded draw effect from 2 to 1[/list][/list]

notes.title: 1.1.3 Hotfix update
notes.notes:
Hello, agents! 

We have just released another hotfix update for Nitro Kid! 

Find the patch notes below 👇

[u][b]1.1.3 Hotfix Patch Notes - November 16, 2022[/b][/u]

The following changes have been implemented in-game:

[list]
[*] Fixed Mission Impossible Achievement
[*] Fixed Personal Bubble+ Shield gain
[*] Fixed Meditate max HP gain bug
[*] Fixed The Feuer Boss soft-lock
[*] HitSound now plays on Enemy death
[*] Enemy Burn damage now applies to props as well
[*] Improved backup-system for save files
[*] Pressure is now included in cleanse all buff effects
[*]Smaller bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you all for all the feedback, bug reports, and support! See you on the Nitro Kid channels! 💪👊

[url="https://tblink.co/NKDiscord" style=button][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/ce9a7bad48c6a33a61ae2d94614879436222ca45.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 1.1.1 Hotfix update
notes.notes:
Hello, agents! 

We are happy to share that we have recently (November 12) implemented a new hotfix patch!

Find the patch notes below 👇

[u][b]1.1.1 Hotfix Patch Notes - November 12, 2022[/b][/u]

The following changes have been implemented in-game:

[list]
[*] The Bibliophile achievement should fire now when you open the Codex (if you unlocked everything already)
[*] Be Water Patch bug has been fixed
[*] Some issues with Asian fonts have been fixed
[*] One Punch's damage is now shown correctly in the deck view
[*] Duplicating One Punch increases its damage now, instead of adding a copy
[*] Commander has been nerfed from 2x2 -> 1x2 base damage and 350HP -> 300HP
[/list]

Thank you all for all the feedback, bug reports, and support! See you on the Nitro Kid channels! 💪👊

[url="https://tblink.co/NKDiscord" style=button][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/ce9a7bad48c6a33a61ae2d94614879436222ca45.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 1.1.0 update is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello, agents!
 
How are you? We hope you are teaching [i]INFINITY [/i]security forces a lesson! 💪 

We're excited to share that we've updated the game with new difficulty modes, unique agent buffs, and other improvements!

Read the patch notes for more details, and feel free to join our [url=https://tblink.co/NKDiscord]Official Discord server[/url] if you have any feedback or questions! More updates coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/ab4914adfa2ac8de54f9df5c94c7e81d322329dc.png[/img]

[b]New features and balance:[/b]
[list][*][b]New difficulty modes: [/b]
[list][*][b]Simulation[/b]: Heal 30 HP at crystals, start with an Avatar Patch giving +1 Energy, basic cards are already upgraded, start with $200
[*][b]Reality[/b]: Heal 30 HP at crystals. 25% bonus score and experience
[*][b]Security 0[/b]: Heal 20 HP at crystals. Increased enemy damage and HP, Removing a card and upgrading a patch costs $25 more. 50% bonus to score and experience[/list]
[*][b]Temporary and unique Player Buffs now show in the Player Buff UI [/b]
[list][*][b]L33[/b]: Maximum Effort and  Recursive Method. 
[*][b]J4X[/b]: Underdog, Square Up, Paw, Magic Mitts, Ego Boost, Divine Fists
[*][b]Infusion[/b]: Aluminium[/list]
[*]Small improvements to the Codex and Unlock Intel UI 
[*]Show version number, seed and difficulty in-game
[*]Show Hero Patch in hero selection, and make loadout minis hoverable
[*]Added deck count UI
[*]Removed Beelzebub from the normal Patch pool (it needs a design rework)
[*]Redesigned Commander Boss
[*]Reduced the Brain enemies’ Shield gain from 3 to 2
[*][b]Slightly reduced the following enemies’ HP values:[/b]
[list][*][b]Business Act[/b]: All normal enemies, The Scientist, and The Fire Warden
[*][b]Mech Act[/b]: Battle Mech, Buff Bot, Tackle Bot, Flame Bot, Auto Gunner, Technician, Shield Turret[/list]
[*][b]Slightly reduced the following enemies’ Damage values:[/b]
[list][*][b]Business Act[/b]: Shotgun Yuppie, The Fire Warden, The Founder
[*][b]Mech Act[/b]: Battle Mech, Pursuit Bot, Tackle Bot, The Test Subject, The Broodmother
[*][b]Experiment Act[/b]: Cadet, Aberration, Prodigy, Poacher, Radiation Bot.[/list]
[*]Increased the damage of The Vine Queen and her Shrubs slightly.
[*]Increased The Vine Queen’s strength gain on Bug Card played from 2 to 4.
[*][b]K31 Balance Changes:[/b]
[list][*]Small Bore - Increased Chamber value by 1
[*]Bullet Witch - Changed effect text from [i]“Whenever you Chamber while at max Ammo, Gain 1 Strength.”[/i] to [i]“Whenever you Chamber beyond your max Ammo, Gain 1 Strength.”[/i]
[*]Opening Shot - Reduced Damage from 5 to 4[/list]
[*][b]L33 Balance Changes:[/b]
[list][*]Death Strike - Reduced Energy cost from 2 to 1
[*]Firestorm - Increased Energy cost from 1 to 3, increased effects by ~300%
[*]Discombobulate - Increased Damage by ~50%
[*]Replaced 1 Block Card from L33’s starting deck 
[*]Added a new Card “Qi Pulse” to L33’s starting deck[/list]
[*]+30 XP after every run[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Bibliophile Achievement being stuck on 19/22
[*]Reduced Saviour Achievement Kid's saved goal from 1000 to 250 
[*]Backup system for safe files in case of file corruption
[*]Fixed Twins boss soft lock issue
[*]Fixed burn damage on Dragon Punch+ and Erupt+
[*]Fixed bug when selecting cards for Upgrade, Remove, and Tutors (Assassin, Stoke the Fire, etc.) in very large decks
[*]Boomtouch doesn't apply to Plutonium anymore
[*]Cockroach now can't be removed in Events
[*]K31's Tech Expert Patch now can't upgrade Tactical Reload
[*]Fixed Copper Infusion + Cost Up Cards 
[*]Cost reduction effects aren't given to cloned cards
[*]Fix Ambush Event lock for when Player enters with 1 HP
[*]J4X’s Power Drain card now affects Strength from Golden Glove correctly
[*]Maximum Effort + Push Kick now targets correctly
[*]The Hornet’s Damage on Card play is no longer increased by Security levels.
[*]And many more minor bug fixes.[/list]

Thank you all for all the feedback, bug reports, and support! See you around! 💪👊

[url="https://tblink.co/NKDiscord" style=button][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/ce9a7bad48c6a33a61ae2d94614879436222ca45.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Get ready for Nitro Kid’s release on October 18th and join the playtest!
notes.notes:
That's right, agents, get ready for some burning news! 

We're excited to announce that Nitro Kid will be released on October 18th! 
For those of you who are keen to play Nitro Kid sooner, you’re in luck! We're giving you a chance to play the game early with an exclusive pre-release playtest starting today! 

[previewyoutube=QsAubYOWvO8;full][/previewyoutube]  

[h3]How to apply[/h3]
To sign up for the playtest, press the ‘Request Access’ on the game’s page. 

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709050/Nitro_Kid/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/b66ddabad3e0fb1fe9545f431a9ef57e4f153546.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]What’s inside?[/h3]
When you get access to the playtest, you will be randomly assigned with one of the new agents. The playtest also features two floors, new room structure, new music and much more!

[h3]Meet your new playtest partners: J4X and K31[/h3]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/e50409fe084d1586e17b99c13f788c52d3fd65b7.png[/img][/th]
    [td][b]J4X[/b] is a heavy-hitter who thinks like a chess player. He has a unique ability to counter-attack during the enemy turn. You can also build up Combo and Pressure points for devastating knock-outs![/td][/tr]
    [tr][th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/86d33ab241d25840a24b2ab6b51eb5f98c369502.png[/img][/th]
        [td][b]K31[/b] is a glass cannon fighter, a tech and weaponry expert. She can switch between two different stances for ranged and close combat. Each stance comes with unique perks and limitations. You also should consider your ammo type and count (another character specific mechanic).[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3]Share your feedback with us[/h3]
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the demo feedback you provided to us so far. We have taken it into consideration and the game has changed a lot because of it. We encourage you to join the playtest and share your experience with the new agents. 

We created two new discord channels for sharing your insights: #playtest-J4X and #playtest-K31. If you haven't joined our Official Discord server yet, please follow [url=https://tblink.co/NKDiscord]this invitation link[/url] to do so!

[h3]Recap:[/h3]
Nitro Kid full game will be released on October 18th 
Request access to the exclusive pre-release playtest now 
Try one of the new agents - J4X or K31 - and share your experience with the community and the development team on  [url=https://tblink.co/NKDiscord]Discord[/url]!

[h2]Wishlist and follow the game[/h2]
Please consider Following and Wishlisting the game, so you won't miss the upcoming news and sneak peeks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709050/Nitro_Kid/
